steps.content:
Algorithms

Term 1 Test

Year 8

  • First: 20 minutes of revision practice.
  • Then: a 30-minute test on this website.
  • Topics: sequence, selection, FOR and WHILE loops, arrays, linear search, flowchart symbols, finding errors.
Think → Pair → ShareWhich topic do you find hardest?Show the answer

Practise that topic most in the next 20 minutes.

steps.label: Revision Practice
steps.content:
Revision Practice

Think → Pair → ShareA program changes a variable, then an IF tests it. Which value does the IF use?Show the answer

The new value. Lines run in order, top to bottom.

20 minutes. Practise every topic. Trace each program one line at a time.

steps.label: How the Test Works
steps.content:
How the Test Works

Think → Pair → ShareEvery question needs you to trace a program. How can you check an answer?Show the answer

Trace it again, one line at a time. Write down each variable as it changes.

  • You have 30 minutes from when you press Start.
  • Your answers save as you type.
  • During the test you cannot open the rest of the website.
  • The notepad works, but it starts empty. Use it to trace the programs.
  • Press Hand in when you finish. When time runs out, it hands in for you.

steps.label: The Test
steps.content:
The Test

Think → Pair → ShareYou finish early. What should you do?Show the answer

Trace every program again. Check each answer one line at a time.

Wait until your teacher says the test is open. Then press the button, and press Start.
